title: Closed localization of a w-contractible ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, and suppose its closed subset $V(I)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] equals $V(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ for a finite list $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in I$, including $r=0$. Set $S=\{s\in R: s\bmod I\text{ is a unit in }R/I\}$ and $B=S^{-1}R$, the ring of fractions with denominators in $S$. Then $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is a homeomorphism onto the points specializing to $V(I)$, and $B/IB\cong R/I$. The finite family consisting of $\operatorname{Spec}R_{f_k}\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ for $1\leq k\leq r$ and $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. If $R$ is w-contractible, meaning every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $R\to D$ admits an $R$-algebra retraction [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], then $B$ is w-contractible in the same sense.
